title: Paystride Save Servicing Timeframes
content:
The servicing timeframes of Paystride Save are the same on every tier. Two are counted in business days and two in calendar days.

| Timeframe | Starter | Builder | Boost | Growth | Premier | Elite | Counted in |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Within which a fraud or legal freeze is reviewed | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | business days |
| Within which the closing balance is paid out | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | business days |
| After closure before the worker may open again | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | calendar days |
| A pending account waits for identity verification before it lapses | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | calendar days |

### Reading the timeframes

- **Freeze review — 10 business days.** A freeze placed on suspected fraud or a legal order is reviewed within 10 business days.
- **Closing payout — 1 business day.** The closing balance is paid out within 1 business day.
- **Reopening — 30 calendar days.** After an account closes, 30 calendar days pass before the worker may open again.
- **Pending verification — 14 calendar days.** A pending account waits 14 calendar days for identity verification before it lapses.

Business days and calendar days are not interchangeable: the freeze review and the payout run on business days, the reopening wait and the verification wait on calendar days.
